name: Region-conditioned low-rank native memory transform
status: Prospective exploratory cross-validation after training-capacity and full-sequence engineering gates
method: Use Microsoft's pinned author LoRA Linear for three rank-4 residual experts in each of four native memory-attention layers. Mix each token's content-dependent residual by its own stored-prediction soft region memberships, then use native key/value projections, decoder and writer. Keep all native frames, tokens, positional encodings and pointers. No confidence gating, added threshold, frame-quality selection or second read.
global_control: Same initialization, parameter count, training clips and compute; replace within-frame role maps by each frame's own mean memberships.
training_rule: Initialize both arms from identical fresh LoRA factors per fold. One author-sampled clip per training sequence per epoch, 140 updates per arm per fold. Preserve native autoregressive memory writes and raw decoder-mask plus object-presence supervision. Never select weights, epochs or settings using held-out outcomes; use the final epoch. Capacity-diagnostic weights are never reused for CV.
engineering_gate: On complete seq2/seq3, compare zero-adapter predictions against archived native hashes, and current stored masks/memory/pointers/positions against a freshly replayed native run with matched cold positional caches. Verify nonzero-adapter propagation in both arms, all four layers, object ownership and paired key/pointer/frame schedules. Stop on integrity failures; do not stop or retune for surprising accuracy.
capacity_prerequisite: Run 132 must finish with finite optimization, unchanged backbone/source hashes and lower mean fixed training loss in both arms. This is not a held-out improvement screen.
native_reference: Reuse validated Run 118 MedSAM2 native predictions for all 21 promptable sequences. Require matching checkpoint, manifest, repository revision, frame hashes and prompt coverage. No third-party baseline reruns.
primary: Within-sequence mean present-frame Dice, followed by equal-sequence mean; report all 21 sequences including zero-Dice failures, excluding seq1/seq7 only because no prompt is available.
secondary: IoU, official DAVIS Boundary F, GT-empty false alarms/denominators, censored overlap re-detection, actual spatial/pointer key counts and measured runtime. Missing archived native runtime remains unavailable.
inference: Two fixed contrasts: regional minus native and regional minus global control. Whole-sequence bootstrap 95% intervals with 10000 resamples and paired Wilcoxon with Holm across these two contrasts. Patient independence remains unverified.
meaningful_screen: For both contrasts require mean Dice gain at least 0.01, at least 14 of 21 sequence wins, positive lower confidence limit, Holm-adjusted p below 0.05 and no extra pooled GT-empty false alarms. Report failures without redefining success. This remains exploratory after repeated PolypGen development; later independent confirmation and another seed are needed.
